capabilities: Export notes to the clipboard with local images embedded as base64 data URLs
Save pasted base64 image data as timestamped PNG files in a configured vault folder
Expand inline Markdown images and Obsidian image embeds, including spaced and URL-encoded paths
Insert a quote callout marker when pasted text starts with a quote marker
Configure the image storage folder and default embed caption
disambiguation: Not a general image clipboard tool; it only converts between base64 data URLs and vault image files, not regular clipboard image pasting.
extras: Not yet in the official community directory, so it must be installed manually from GitHub releases; mobile clipboard behavior and the minimum Obsidian version still need device testing. Plugin ID changed to img-copy-paste in 0.1.2, with migration instructions for older IDs. Settings labels are written in Chinese with English glosses.
intentEvidence: The export feature was inspired by MD Image Embed by mengzhishanghun
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to copy a note with its local images inlined as base64 for pasting elsewhere, and pasted base64 image data stays as bulky data URLs instead of becoming vault image files.

relations.evidence: The export feature was inspired by MD Image Embed by mengzhishanghun, whose supplied plugin declares the MIT license.

summary: Plugin that copies notes as Markdown with local images embedded as base64 data URLs, and saves pasted base64 images as PNG files in the vault.
